product_brief.brief_description: Create an egg-free vegan mayonnaise emulsion containing at least 45% fat, at most 2% sugar, and thick spoonable consistency. Must achieve stable oil-in-water emulsion without phase separation, creamy mouthfeel, balanced lemon-vinegar acidity, and 9-month ambient stability. Strictly exclude eggs, dairy, and artificial colorants.

final_formulations.manufacturing_process: Stage 1: Prepare aqueous continuous phase with dissolved acidulants, salts, and hydrocolloid stabilizers. | Stage 2: Pre-emulsify plant proteins and emulsifiers into the aqueous phase. | Stage 3: Controlled high-shear inline homogenization while metering the lipid/oil phase to form stable emulsion. | Stage 4: Vacuum de-aeration, preservative dosing, and hermetic packaging under ambient conditions.
